column1: # What this game needs of an Android phone, for the launcher's readiness check (android/README.md "Readiness check"; the format in dm/games/README.md "Readiness rows").
# A status row also marks the game as supported on Android: gradle.properties' nxGames builds every such profile into the APK (dm/tools/tests/test_android_games.py).
# Playable on Android: on a 16 GB AYN Thor (Adreno 740, Turnip 27.0.0-devel), a 71-minute session (61,140 frames) played through
# menus, VP9 and realtime cutscenes, exploration and full combat battles (up to 1,546 draws/frame) at 35-56 fps (median 46.4 fps
# across 67 field/combat windows of 337-1,546 draws/frame, p10 35.2 fps, 35.5 fps at 1,546 draws/frame; the note, Android).
# Qualcomm's stock system driver and chapter-end autosave reloads are not tested yet.
# Compute shared memory from shader_facts.tsv (101,860 shaders, 0 mesh or task programs): 160 compute shaders ask for more than 32,768 bytes (up to 48,128 bytes); none of the
# 15,449 shaders in shader_seen.tsv (boot to the first field) ask for more than 14,896 bytes, and 0 of the 50 compute pipelines built across 60,900 frames into combat hit that limit

column4: Compute shared memory: 160 compute shaders in the full archive take up to 48,128 bytes (0 of the 50 compute pipelines built through combat exceeded 32,768 bytes)

column1: # Memory on the 16 GB AYN Thor (14.9 GiB totalMem) in the first field (frame 20,812): 6.85 GiB PSS / 6.96 GiB RSS, 5.90 GiB MemAvailable

column4: Memory: the game keeps about 7 GB resident while playing, which a phone with less than about 12 GB cannot give it
Memory: verified on a 16 GB handheld only; with less, Android may stop the game when memory runs short
